symptom: Machine home position is lost The machine home position is lost after an absolute encoder alarm.
failure_mode: Battery for the absolute encoder goes dead The absolute encoder battery is dead or the encoder is disconnected, losing position tracking.
failure_mode_name: Battery for the absolute encoder goes dead
corrective_action: Reference the axis Reset the home position and reference the axis: set parameter 1815 APZ bit to 0, power down, jog the axis to the alignment marks, set the APZ bit to 1 and power down again. Reset the home position and reference the axis: set parameter 1815 APZ bit to 0, power down, jog the axis to the alignment marks, set the APZ bit to 1 and power down again.

symptom: Loss of motion in the axis Measured backlash shows loss of motion in the axis.
failure_mode: Backlash in ballscrew and linear guide rails Backlash from the ballscrew and linear guide rails is out of specification.
failure_mode_name: Backlash in ballscrew and linear guide rails
corrective_action: Adjust backlash compensation Adjust backlash compensation according to the procedure in Section 3.33. Adjust backlash compensation according to the procedure in Section 3.33.
